```{r import datasets, include=FALSE}
# Import Luminex Data
  
  table_lum_healthy <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir, "data", "Lum_CarTrans_Healthy_all.xlsx"))  

  table_lum_CarTrans_V0<- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir, "data", "Lum_CarTrans_V0_all.xlsx")) 
   
  table_lum_CarTrans_V1<- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir, "data", "Lum_CarTrans_V1_all.xlsx")) 
  
  table_lum_CarTrans_V2 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir, "data", "Lum_CarTrans_V2_all.xlsx"))
  
  table_lum_CarTrans_V3 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir, "data", "Lum_CarTrans_V3_all.xlsx"))
  
  table_lum_CarTrans_V4 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir,"data", "Lum_CarTrans_V4_all.xlsx"))
  
  table_lum_CarTrans_V5 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir,"data", "Lum_CarTrans_V5_all.xlsx"))
  
table_lum_CarTrans_VX <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir,"data", "Lum_CarTrans_VX_all.xlsx"))

# Delete ATG_EMB column
table_lum_healthy     <- table_lum_healthy     %>% select(-ATG_EMB1_3)
table_lum_CarTrans_V0 <- table_lum_CarTrans_V0 %>% select(-ATG_EMB1_3)
table_lum_CarTrans_V1 <- table_lum_CarTrans_V1 %>% select(-ATG_EMB1_3)
table_lum_CarTrans_V2 <- table_lum_CarTrans_V2 %>% select(-ATG_EMB1_3)
table_lum_CarTrans_V3 <- table_lum_CarTrans_V3 %>% select(-ATG_EMB1_3)


# Combine Tables
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- rbind(table_lum_CarTrans_V0, table_lum_CarTrans_V1, table_lum_CarTrans_V2, table_lum_CarTrans_V3, table_lum_CarTrans_V4, table_lum_CarTrans_V5, table_lum_CarTrans_VX, table_lum_healthy)%>%
    mutate(across(-c(Study_ID, Visit), ~{
        x <- as.numeric(as.character(.))  
      })) %>% 
    filter(!Study_ID %in% c("CarTrans-Long-31", "CarTrans-Long-37", "CarTrans-Long-38", "CarTrans-Long-39", "CarTrans-Long-40", "CarTrans-Long-41", "CarTrans-Long-42", "CarTrans-Long-43", "CarTrans-Long-44", "CarTrans-Long-45", "CarTrans-Long-46", "CarTrans-Long-47", "CarTrans-Long-48", "CarTrans-Long-49", "CarTrans-Long-50", "CarTrans-Long-51", "CarTrans-Healthy-29", "CarTrans-Healthy-30", "CarTrans-Healthy-31", "CarTrans-Healthy-32", "CarTrans-Healthy-33", "CarTrans-Healthy-34", "CarTrans-Healthy-35", "CarTrans-Healthy-36", "CarTrans-Healthy-37", "CarTrans-Healthy-38", "CarTrans-Healthy-39", "CarTrans-Healthy-40", "CarTrans-Healthy-41", "CarTrans-Healthy-42", "CarTrans-Healthy-43", "CarTrans-Healthy-44", "CarTrans-Healthy-45", "CarTrans-Healthy-46", "CarTrans-Healthy-47", "CarTrans-Healthy-48","CarTrans-Healthy-49", "CarTrans-Healthy-50")) #Exclude unmeasured samples
```

```{r clean overall table}
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  select(-ISHLT_1990, -ISHLT_2004, -Class_Sup, -Transplantation_risk)
```

```{r prep metadata}
# Rename visits in overall table
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(
    Visit = as.character(Visit),
    Visit = case_when(
    Visit == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",
    Visit == "V0" ~ "Baseline",
    Visit == "V1" ~ "Week 1",
    Visit == "V2" ~ "Week 2",
    Visit == "V3" ~ "Month 1-3",
    Visit == "V4" ~ "Month 4-6",
    Visit == "V5" ~ "Month 12",
    grepl("^VX", Visit) ~ Visit, #keep different X timepoints to not create duplicates
    TRUE~Visit
    ),
    Visit = factor(Visit,levels = c("Healthy","Baseline","Week 1","Week 2","Month 1-3","Month 4-6","Month 12", "VX1", "VX2", "VX3", "VX4")) 
  )

# Assign unique sample IDs for each study ID
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(Sample_ID = paste(Study_ID, Visit, sep = "_"))
```

```{r r heatmap, fig.height =9, fig.width=13, out.width="100%"}
# Create annotation table
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(Timepoint= case_when(grepl("^VX", Visit) ~ "Rejection Context",TRUE ~ Visit))

list_Timepoint <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Visit, Timepoint)

 list_Timepoint$Timepoint = factor(list_Timepoint$Timepoint,levels = c("Healthy","Baseline","Week 1","Week 2","Month 1-3","Month 4-6","Month 12", "Rejection Context")) 

rownames(list_Timepoint) <- list_Timepoint$Sample_ID
list_Timepoint <- list_Timepoint[, c("Timepoint"), drop = FALSE]  #,"Visit" add Visit into c() to get two factor grouping of overall visits groups and keep also all visits

# Remove metadata columns
table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01 <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  dplyr::select(-Study_ID, -Visit, -Sample_ID)

# Convert Data Table to Data Frame
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01 <- as.data.frame(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01)
  
# Select preserved cytokines
#  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01 <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01 %>%
#                              dplyr::select(HGF, IL2R, CXCL9, CXCL10, CXCL8, IL6, CCL3, CCL4)

# Transpose Data Table
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t <- t(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01)

## Column Annotations
  colnames(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t) <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall$Sample_ID


## Row Annotations
  # Create list with Parameters 
    list_parameter_groups <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir,"data", "Grouping of Luminex Marker.xlsx"))

  # Create list with Columns of data table
    list_parameter_datatable <- as.data.frame(rownames(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t))
                                colnames(list_parameter_datatable) <- "Parameter"

  # Merge to match the order of parameters
    list_parameter_groups_01 <- merge(list_parameter_groups, list_parameter_datatable, by.y = "Parameter")

# Define the predefined order for Group
  group_order <- c("Cytokine", "Chemokine", "Growth factor/Tissue Cytokine", "Activation Marker")

# Order list based on predefined order
#  selected_markers <- c("HGF","IL2R", "CXCL9", "CXCL10", "IL6", "CCL3", "CCL4")
  
# Filter and order
  list_parameter_groups_02 <- list_parameter_groups_01 %>%
#                              filter(Parameter %in% selected_markers) %>%
                              mutate(Grouping = factor(Grouping, levels = group_order)) %>%
#                              Parameter = factor(Parameter, levels = selected_markers)) %>%
                              arrange(Parameter)
  
# Extract ordered parameter vector
  list_parameter_groups_03 <- as.character(list_parameter_groups_02$Parameter)

# Reorder Data Table based on the new ordered list
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered <- as.data.frame(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t)
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t[list_parameter_groups_03, ]

# Convert it back to matrix
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered <- as.matrix(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered)

#Convert back to numeric
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered <- matrix(
    as.numeric(trimws(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered)),
    nrow = nrow(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered),
    dimnames = dimnames(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered))
  
# Log Transform 
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered <- log2(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered)
  
# Scale 
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered <- t(apply(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered, 1, scale))

  
# Create Cohort Label Colors of Annotations in heatmap
  ann_colors <- list(
    #Visit = c(
    #"Baseline" = "#E0F7FA",
    #"Week 1" = "#B2EBF2",
    #"Week 2" = "#A8C7FF",
    #"Month 1-3" = "#4DD0E1",
    #"Month 4-6" = "#0097A7",
    #"Month 12" = "#1E3FA3",
    #"Rejection" = "#FF6B6B",
    #"Healthy" = "grey",
    #"VX1" = "#FFCCCC",
    #"VX2" = "#FF9999",
    #"VX3" = "#FF6666"
  #),
  Timepoint = c(
    "Baseline" = "#E0F7FA",
    "Week 1" = "#B2EBF2",
    "Week 2" = "#A8C7FF",
    "Month 1-3" = "#4DD0E1",
    "Month 4-6" = "#0097A7",
    "Month 12" = "#1E3FA3",
    "Rejection Context" = "#FF6B6B",
    "Healthy" = "grey",
    "VX1" = "#FFCCCC",
    "VX2" = "#FF9999",
    "VX3" = "#FF6666"),
  Grouping = c(
    "Cytokine" = "darkseagreen",
    "Chemokine" = "lightblue", 
    "Growth factor/Tissue Cytokine" = "mediumpurple3",
    "Activation Marker" =  "lightpink"))

# Column Annotation
  col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = list_Timepoint, col = ann_colors)

# Row Annotation
  #  Prepare row annotations as a data frame
  row_anno <- rowAnnotation(Grouping = list_parameter_groups_02$Grouping,
                            col = list(Grouping = ann_colors$Grouping))

# Create Heatmap
  heatmap_lum <- Heatmap(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered, 
                         name = "Expression",  
                         col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-5, 0, 5), c("blue", "white", "red")),  
                         cluster_rows = TRUE,  
                         cluster_columns = TRUE,  
                         clustering_method_columns = "ward.D",  
                         show_column_names = TRUE,  
                         column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),  
                         row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),  
                         width = unit(18, "cm"), height = unit(15, "cm"),  
                         top_annotation = col_anno,
                         right_annotation = row_anno)

# Draw Heatmap
  show(heatmap_lum)
  
```

# Visualization with Z score

```{r compute z score}
#Define analytes
analyte_cols <- setdiff(colnames(table_lum_CarTrans_overall), c("Study_ID", "Timepoint", "Sample_ID", "ISHLT_2004", "Visit"))

# Log transform input values
table_lum_CarTrans_overall_z <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(analyte_cols), ~ log2(pmax(., 1))))

# Calculate healthy mean and SD as reference
healthy_ref <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall_z %>%
  filter(Visit == "Healthy") %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(analyte_cols),
                   list(mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
                        sd   = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE))))

# Calculate Z score
z_data <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall_z

for (col in analyte_cols) {
  mu <- healthy_ref[[paste0(col, "_mean")]]
  sd <- healthy_ref[[paste0(col, "_sd")]]
  
  if (is.na(sd) || sd == 0) {
    z_data[[col]] <- NA
  } else {
    z_data[[col]] <- (z_data[[col]] - mu) / sd
  }
}

# Set global score per sample
z_data <- z_data %>%mutate(global_z = rowMeans(across(all_of(analyte_cols)), na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r visualize timeline per patient}
z_data <- z_data %>%
  mutate(Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("Healthy", "Baseline", "Week 1", "Week 2","Month 1-3", "Month 4-6", "Month 12", "Rejection Context")))

ggplot(z_data %>% filter(Visit != "Healthy"),
       aes(x = Timepoint, y = global_z, group = Study_ID)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "line", size = 1.5, color = "red") +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0), plot.caption.position = "plot") +
  labs(title = "Longitudinal Immune Profiling",
       y = "Global Z-score (vs Healthy)",
    caption = "*Global Z-score: mean Z-score across all analytes")
  
```
```{r plot heatmap z score, fig.width=5, fig.height=11}
# Average z-score per Timepoint
heatmap_data <- z_data %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(analyte_cols), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Put Timepoint as column names
rownames(heatmap_data) <- heatmap_data$Timepoint
heatmap_data <- heatmap_data %>%
  select(-Timepoint)

# Transpose:
# rows = analytes
# columns = Timepoint
heatmap_mat <- t(as.matrix(heatmap_data))


# Plot
Heatmap(heatmap_mat,
  name = "Z-score",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-3, 0, 3),c("blue", "white", "red")),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_names_side = "right",
  column_names_side = "top",
  clustering_method_columns = "ward.D",
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  show_row_names = TRUE
)
```
